source_text: Butyrum et mel manducabit. Quomodo Christus prophetatur comedens butyrum et mel — antequam sciat reprobare malum et eligere bonum. Signum in nobis nascitur cum Emmanuel nobiscum Deus; qui aperit et introit cenat nobiscum. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Butter and honey he will eat. How Christ is prophesied eating butter and honey — before he knows to refuse evil and choose good. The sign is born in us when Emmanuel is God with us; he who opens and enters dines with us. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Butter and honey he shall eat >> Bible:Isaiah 7:15]] — before he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good. Immanuel is [[God with us >> Bible:Matthew 1:23]]; the risen Lord [[stands at the door and knocks >> Bible:Revelation 3:20]] so that we may dine with him. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
